component.name: Dialog
component.summary: Chat, group calls and screen sharing

description.p: Dialog is a fast, no-nonsense messenger for text chat, group voice and video calls, and screen sharing. The desktop client adds native notifications, a system tray and deep links on top of the same app that runs in the browser and on Android.

Calls are peer-to-peer: audio, video and screen share flow directly between participants over WebRTC, so no media server sits in the middle of them. Messages travel over TLS and are stored on the server you or the hosted instance runs — they are not end-to-end encrypted.

ul.li: Direct and group messaging with reactions, edits, replies, voice notes, GIFs and files
Peer-to-peer group voice and video calls
Native desktop notifications and tray integration
Themes, including a built-in theme editor
Two-factor authentication and a session self-destruct timer
Fully self-hostable — run the whole stack yourself

First release of the Dialog desktop client.
